Diablo IV Patch Notes

Here you will find all patch notes for Diablo IV, updated as new patches release.

3.2.2 | 3.2.1 | 3.2.0

3.2.2 Build #73764 (All Platforms) - September 30, 2026

Season

  • Fixed an issue where the Season questline could stall when rushing into the Worldstone Chamber portal.
  • Fixed an issue where Chamber of Bone gave no rewards on completion.

Classes

  • Druid
    • Fixed an issue where Pulverize could keep a Staggered boss immobilized forever.
  • Sorcerer
    • Fixed an issue where burn damage from the Incinerate Enchantment did not trigger the Tal rune.
    • Increased Frost Nova damage from 40% to 55%.

Miscellaneous

  • Various stability, performance and visual improvements.

3.2.1 Build #73512 (All Platforms) - September 22, 2026

Game Updates

  • Added a new Helltide reward chest.
  • Fixed an issue where the Lore Runeword helm became invisible when worn.

Developer's Note: We will keep monitoring feedback on the Helltide changes.

3.2.0 Build #73100 (All Platforms)

August 12, 2026

User Interface

  • Pinned currency is now highlighted in the Stats & Materials tab.
